Mixed purées

Zucchini, pea, salmon, and couscous

Cukkini, borsó, lazac, kuszkusz

6 months+ Adjusted 25 min 4 portions

Look through the salmon for bones, and smash every pea. This contains gluten and fish.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 40 g fine couscous (wheat, so gluten)
  • 80 ml hot water (unsalted)
  • 80 g zucchini (peeled and cooked soft)
  • 60 g peas (to be smashed)
  • 100 g skinless boneless salmon (fresh or plain frozen, not smoked)

Allergens

glutenfish

Method

  1. Peel and cook the zucchini, and cook the peas until they squash easily.
  2. Cook the salmon until it is opaque and flakes, then cool it enough to handle.
  3. Flake the salmon and remove every bone.
  4. Stir the couscous into the hot water, cover for 5 minutes, then mash it with a little extra water so no dry grains remain.
  5. Smash the peas and mash salmon, zucchini, and couscous together until spoonable.
  6. Do not add salt.

Adjusted

Couscous is wheat, so this contains gluten. Whole peas and a leftover fish bone are the texture hazards.

Smash the peas, and flake boneless salmon only after the bones are checked. Stir them into soft couscous with cooked zucchini.
